response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg_bandwidth) AS avg_group_bandwidth_usage, AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_group_telescope_count FROM (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS group_avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) AS groups
